name: Freekeh
siboNotes: High in fructans and should be avoided during SIBO treatment phases. Consider substituting with quinoa or rice for similar texture.
preparationTips: Rinse thoroughly before cooking to remove debris
Toast lightly in a dry pan before adding liquid for enhanced nutty flavor
Use 2.5:1 water to freekeh ratio when cooking
Simmer covered for 20-25 minutes until tender
